run_generate_predicted_spans: run the script to generate predicted object spans from natural language utterances using LLaMA
normalize_caption: normalize a caption string by lowercasing and removing punctuation and spaces
load_csv_utterances: load utterances from CSV files across sr3d, nr3d, and scanrefer dataset splits
generate_spans_with_llama: generate primary subject spans from scene descriptions using a text-generation pipeline
save_predicted_spans: save predicted span targets and utterance hashes to a PyTorch checkpoint file
